objective: Validate the existing routing implementation on a public routing benchmark before any additional financial-data collection or model calls.

dataset.split_policy: Use the official train split for fitting and the official test split exactly once for evaluation.
dataset.note: The downloaded artifact contains 4489 train queries although the dataset card states 4487; artifact counts and hashes are authoritative for this run.

candidate_selection_rule: Eight models selected before inspecting test performance, using only candidate metadata to cover distinct architectures and scales from 7B to 671B.

models.hard_classification: class-balanced logistic regression over canonical argmax labels
models.performance_prediction: multi-output Ridge regression over per-model performance

tie_policy: A canonical label uses the first tied model in frozen candidate order; routing accuracy is also reported tie-aware.

bootstrap.unit: query with all candidate outcomes paired

failure_action: Stop before E1 and diagnose implementation, target construction, candidate pool, or benchmark signal.
pass_action: Freeze E0 artifacts, then begin E1 financial routability audit without collecting new responses.
